acceptance_claim: Native file component checks only; no assigned Stage 02 criterion is marked passed.

second_process.scope: real second local Foundation-coordinated writer over public synthetic temporary text; no provider accounts

fixed_during_review: NSFileCoordinator opened a FIFO before the accessor, blocking the first hostile-input check. Preflight file-type checks now run before coordination. The final hostile-input check passes in 0.013 seconds without intervention.
Atomic create uses RENAME_EXCL so another file created after the first check is not overwritten.
Replacement rechecks exact source bytes inside coordination before rename and retains file security metadata and extended attributes.
limitations: No NSDocument, library, conflict-sheet or scheduler integration is claimed by this checkpoint.
Real sandbox bookmark grants, stale bookmarks, revoked permissions and real iCloud/Google Drive sessions remain NOT MEASURED. Grant lifecycle tests use an injected provider.
Cooperating writers are coordinated; a malicious local process that bypasses coordination can still race the filesystem.
The preflight check is advisory; it is not a guarantee against another process replacing a node after preflight.
File replacement has fault-injected failure points; no physical power loss/full volume or real provider outage measured.
After replacement but before directory synchronization failure yields durability-uncertain rather than a Saved acknowledgement.
The caller needs sufficient grants for a same-folder temporary file; actual sandbox parent-folder behavior remains to be verified.
No app UI/VoiceOver/typing latency or universal application build with these components measured.
